_about: For each document of tools/make_text_box_top_probe.py, the page, pen x and baseline (device px, 300 per inch) of the first glyph of each swept text box's labelled lines as Word 16.106 drew them, and the labels the model missed on each axis at recording time; the numbers of every face the model asked for. Measurements only; regenerate with tools/read_text_box_top_probe.py --record.
